invariants.rule: Exactly one search authority owner exists and it is SUPERVISOR.
L4 requests evaluation only and never creates, selects, or commits a candidate.
Only SOURCE_NATIVE_EXISTING is authorized by default in V2.
Synthetic and outcome-conditioned generation are forbidden.
All seven candidate provenance fields are mandatory and immutable.
Any identity-field change requires a new candidate ID.
Every alternative receives fresh C0, L1, L2, and L3 evidence without certificate reuse.
New alternative evaluation is permitted only in DEADLINE_OPEN.
Every alternative uses the frozen map, geometry, actuator, state, and controller identities.
Backup witness generation is L3 authority and is not alternative source generation.
Alternative failure or absence does not imply unsafe state.
UNKNOWN_SOURCE never converts to PASS or execution authority.
